headlines.title: Southern Energy Corp. Announces Restricted Share Award Grant
headlines.summary: CALGARY, AB / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / ("Southern" or the "Company") (TSXV:SOU)(AIM:SOUC) announces that pursuant to the Company's Share Award Incentive Plan, an aggregate of 600,000 restricted share awards ("RSAs") were granted as part of Southern's overall compensation and employee retention program.The RSAs vest as to one third on each of the first, second and third anniversaries of the grant date.

headlines.title: Raised Outlook Might Change The Case For Investing In Southern Stock (SO)
headlines.summary: Southern Company has completed a US$1.75b composite equity units offering, issuing 35,000,000 equity derivative units at US$50 each with a US$0.75 discount per security and a US$875m principal amount allocated twice within the structure. The mix of equity linked funding and derivative units adds another lever for Southern Company to support its large capital program while managing balance sheet pressure from rising data center and corporate electricity demand.

headlines.title: Southern (SO) Stock Looks About Right On Current Earnings
headlines.summary: Southern has delivered steady gains for long term holders. With fresh spending plans and funding moves in the headlines, the live question is whether the current share price is still supported by its earnings power. With the stock around US$94.11, investors are increasingly focused on how much of that tag is tied to today’s profit base versus expectations about what comes next. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 84.

headlines.title: State Street Utilities SPDR (XLU) Sells $32.8 Million of NextEra on Nov. 23
headlines.summary: The $23.35 billion fund sold $253.3 million of stock and bought nothing, cutting all 31 positions.

headlines.title: Investors Buy Unusually Large LEAP Options in Southeastern Utility, Southern Company
headlines.summary: Investors have bought huge, unusual amounts of long-dated calls (i.e., LEAPs) in a utility benefiting from strong corporate demand - Southern Co. (SO). These LEAPs show investors love SO stock for the long term.

description: The Southern Company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electricity. The company offers electric service to retail customers and wholesale customers; and energy-related products and services to natural gas choice markets. It also develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates, and manages power generation assets, as well as battery energy storage projects; sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market; and deploys microgrids for commercial, industrial, governmental, and utility customers. In addition, the company is involved in the distribution of natural gas in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, and Tennessee; distributes energy and resilience solutions; and invests in telecommunications. The Southern Company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
